thread:
anya: quick question — we want to run a one-off prune of old staging traces after the trace-store migration to free up ~2TB. plan is: snapshot the list of keys -> upload audit snapshot -> delete traces older than 30 days under s3://redwood-traces/staging/. need security + data-owner OK before we run. any blockers?

sanjay: what exactly is in those traces? do they contain customer identifiers or request payloads?

anya: sample of one trace (redacted):
```json
{"trace_id":"abc123","service":"router","duration_ms":42,"user_id":"U_xxx_redacted","request":{"path":"/api/generate","headers":{"cookie":"REDACTED"}}}
```
small sample shows a user_id field and some header data. i only sampled 10 files so far.

ellen: thanks for the context. two quick asks before approval: 1) please list exact s3 prefixes and count/size snapshot; 2) create a ticket and attach the snapshot so we have an audit trail. if traces contain PII we can still delete, but legal wants the record. who is the data owner for staging traces?

anya: created ticket TICKET-4991 and uploaded initial key-list snapshot to s3://redwood-audit/trace-prune/1715006789-keys.json. prefixes: staging/2023-*, staging/2024-01-*. estimated objects: ~450k, size ~2.1TB. tag on the ticket: @sanjay for data-owner.

devops-bot: :robot_face: prune-job draft created (prune-v1). schedule: 2024-06-01 03:00 UTC. status: PENDING_MANUAL_APPROVAL.

sanjay: quick note on rollback / safety — i'll run a dry-run first with this CLI: 
```bash
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-traces/staging/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '2023*' --dryrun
# then: aws s3 rm ... --recursive --exclude '*' --include '2023*' --dryrun --older-than 30
```
also recommend snapshotting object metadata (size, etag, last-modified) to the audit bucket before delete.

ellen: that sounds good. security sign-off conditions: audit snapshot present in redwood-audit, ticket TICKET-4991 has approval comments from data-owner + security, and a reviewer (ellen) listed for post-delete verification. also record the operator who runs the job.

anya: plan updated on TICKET-4991: added a metadata snapshot step and operator checklist. will run scrub step on any traces we keep (remove user identifiers) using jq: `jq 'del(.user_id, .request.headers.cookie)'`. legal notified for visibility.

sanjay: LGTM. i'll be on standby to run the dry-run and deletion.

ellen: security approves contingent on the checklist being completed in ticket. please ping me in this thread once the dry-run output is uploaded. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks — i will upload dry-run keylist by EOD and ping here. planning manual approval window tomorrow 02:50 UTC to snapshot, then run delete at 03:00 UTC if all checks pass.
